id: THE GOLDEN AWESOME W/ BEACH BALLS, CERAMIC & S.L REFLEX-Valhalla, Wellington-Valhalla
name: THE GOLDEN AWESOME W/ BEACH BALLS, CERAMIC & S.L REFLEX
long_description:
After converging at PSY FI festival in May for the first time since Covid, shoegazers the Golden Awesome are playing in Wellington again - this time with a bunch of their friends.

Beach Balls are psych rock meets motorik drone, Ceramic is 80s infused trippy synth wave, S.L. Reflex is mystery electro pop. Visuals by Mike Heynes.

Tickets on UTR

id: CINDY (AUK) ALBUM RELEASE W/ CRUELLY & HOMING-Valhalla, Wellington-Valhalla
name: CINDY (AUK) ALBUM RELEASE W/ CRUELLY & HOMING
long_description:
One of the most magnificent live bands in Aotearoa (maybe the best?) and certainly the wildest, Cindy last month spilled the beans about their long-anticipated debut album The Way I Do, out on 4th September via 1:12 Records and Sunreturn, and now they've gone and announced an eight date nationwide release tour.

First choice local supports for such legendary garage-punk combos as Hard-Ons, Guitar Wolf, King Brothers and OFF!, the Tāmaki four-piece of Scott Brown, James King, Gloria Florence, and Arlo Grey will be hitting stages (and surrounding rafters / mosh pits) near you this spring.

Tickets here

id: SHRED FEST - FEAT OBSCURA (GER), FVKVSHIMA & GUESTS, WELLINGTON-Valhalla, Wellington-Valhalla
name: SHRED FEST - FEAT OBSCURA (GER), FVKVSHIMA & GUESTS, WELLINGTON
long_description:
Tickets here

SHRED FEST 2026 is coming! The renowned travelling metal festival will storm across New Zealand, delivering an unmatched celebration of technical excellence, intensity, and musical precision.

This year’s New Zealand edition features two of the most acclaimed names in modern extreme metal Obscura (GER) & Fvkvshima (NZ)

OBSCURA (GER) – Progressive death metal pioneers and masters of technical virtuosity. Following two successful Australian tours along with a return to New Zealand, OBSCURA is back to present their latest album A Sonication as part of their ongoing world tour.

Joining the international lineup are one of New Zealands most formidable local acts:

FVKVSHIMA - A progressive, driving, mechanical powerhouse surfacing from the shores of Wellington, NZ. Gargantuan, lurching drop-tuned phrases, layered with soaring apocalyptic textures. Resurrecting members from Shakahn, Backyard Burial, Planet of the Dead, and Diecast, FVKVSHIMA has collective decades of songwriting experience across a variety of genres, now condensed into its menacing live set.

Additional guests will appear in every city on this tour

Line Up
OBSCURA (GER)
FVKVSHIMA (NZ)
+ Special Guests

Dates
15/09 NZ Auckland – Whammy
16/09 NZ Wellington – Valhalla
17/09 NZ Christchurch – Churchills Tavern

SHRED FEST 2026 promises a diverse and uncompromising showcase of extreme metal — from technical precision to devastating heaviness. Expect the ultimate convergence of musicianship, passion, and power.

Tickets on sale via www.yourmatebookings.com & https://www.shredfest.net/

Obscura shared their thoughts on the upcoming tour:
"We're thrilled to bring Shred Fest to Australia in 2026 alongside the crushing talents of Fallujah, Anoxia, and Ashen. It’s been a long time coming, and we're ready to deliver a relentless set for our fans down under. No VIP packages — every band will be at the venue to meet you, talk music, and celebrate the most extreme sounds around. Come early, stay late, and support every act. We can’t wait to see you all there."

Official SHRED FEST channels;

Website: https://www.shredfest.net/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61569365417641 / https://www.facebook.com/shredfestausnz / https://www.facebook.com/yourmatebookings
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/shredfest_moreisnotenough / https://www.instagram.com/shredfestausnz/
Tiktok: @shredfest_world
YouTube: youtube.com/@SHREDFEST_MOREISNOTENOUGH

All Interviews and Press Enquiries; please get in touch with Anthony ab@yourmatebookings.com

name: VAMPIRE DYSKO
long_description:
VAMPIRE DISKO: THE DEBUT 

Advance tickets at: https://buytickets.at/12xuproductions/2269600

For one evening only, Wellington descends into darkness as "vampyres" (don't worry, vampires aren't real...or are they?), goths, and nocturnal misfits gather on the dance floor for the city's first ever VAMPIRE DISKO

Wellington's newest night of Goth, Post-Punk, EBM, Dark Synth Pop, Post Punk, Industrial and Wave for creatures of the night who enjoy getting dressed as vampires, or at least being around people that do!

We invite you to arrive dressed for the eternal night inspired by cult classic vampire films such as Interview with the Vampire, Queen of the Damned, The Lost Boys, The Hunger, Nosferatu and sooo many more... The more dramatic your look, the better! Victorian, Modern, or Halloween Vampire- your efforts will not go unnoticed!

MUSIC IS DECIDEDLY DARK: Expect DJs playing a large amount of 80s classic goth like Bauhaus, Sisters of Mercy, Siouxsie and the Banshees, Christian Death, Clan of Xymox, Skinny Puppy, Nitzer Ebb, Front 242, classic dark 80s like Depeche Mode, Soft Cell, The Cure, Echo and the Bunnymen and New Order and many cutting edge brand new artists who lean toward the dark side. Think She Past Away, Boy Harsher, Riki, Kontravoid, Lebanon Hanover, Nox Novacula, H.Ä.L.T., The Frozen Autumn, Patriarchy....

And for those of who you want a taste of 90s-10s, we won't completely shy away, but you simply MUST request a song in the Facebook event if you really have your heart set on something.

Soundtracking the night: DJ Matai, Nightmare + Coffin Nail spinning until the early hours. We DO of course plan to have you in bed before SUNLIGHT HITS!

This is a LGBTQIA+ friendly event where self-expression is encouraged and the dance floor belongs to everyone.

Sharpen your fangs. Dress to kill. Join us for Wellington's most exciting night of the year!

The first Vampire Disko begins on Friday, September 25th
 See you after darkness falls

9pm-2am
Friday, Sept 25th 2026
Valhalla
154 Vivian Street
Te Aro, Wellington 6011
18+

 Presale tickets are limited. Get yours before they sell out
